current.text: Signed with the Pelicans and joins their bench.
Projected to play about eight fewer minutes per game than last season. He could take shots away from Fears, Murphy, Murray and Zion.

The Pelicans rotation is crowded. Murray, Murphy and Zion are locked in as starters. Fears or Herb Jones and Missi or Queen compete for the other spots, and Saddiq Bey is also in the mix. Mathurin is not part of the starter talk.
The Pelicans need to trade someone to make room for Mathurin, possibly Jordan Hawkins or Micah Peavy.
The Pelicans are projected as a weak team near the bottom of the West, at about 34 wins and out of the playoffs.
New coach Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first identity to the Pelicans.

durable.text: Drives well and gets to the rim and the free throw line.
Does not defend, pass or shoot well, and his defensive numbers are bad.
Rebounds well for a wing, at over 5 per game in each of the last two seasons.

note: Yahoo (rank 156) and ESPN (rank 187) both value him at 0 USD. That puts him outside the 144 players drafted in our league, even though he cost 4 USD in our last auction. The sites see his role very differently: ESPN projects 29.2 minutes and 16.5 points, while Yahoo's line projects only 11.2 points on 8.2 shots. His only standout category is FT%, at 85% on real free throw volume, and he has no punt build fit, so leave him on waivers. Early in the season, check his bench minutes and whether a Pelicans trade or an injury in the crowded rotation gives him a bigger role.
